place.plan.description: Closed placement evidence request; no user-supplied release, stability, contact or success assertions.

object_ref.description: Current-observation target_ref for the visible object being placed, from vision.segment or vision.ground; stale references are rejected. The selected mask is not semantic identity ground truth.

destination_kind.description: Destination geometry family for this placement. support_surface places onto a visible supporting patch and has no opening. open_container places into an upward-open container and also requires destination_boundary_ref naming its visible rim. front_cavity places through a front aperture onto visible interior support and also requires destination_boundary_ref naming that aperture or frame. Dimensionless closed vocabulary; a whole-object mask or its centroid is not a functional region.

destination_support_ref.description: Current-observation target_ref selecting the visible supporting patch the object is placed on: the support patch itself for support_surface, the visible interior support for open_container and front_cavity. Dimensionless reference, not a coordinate. A hidden bottom cannot be inferred as evidence, and the parent object's mask is not the patch.

destination_boundary_ref.description: Current-observation target_ref selecting the visible functional opening — the rim for open_container, the front aperture or frame for front_cavity — or null when the destination has none. Required for those two kinds and refused for support_surface, each as a structured error naming this field rather than a schema branch. Dimensionless reference; a whole-container mask or its centroid does not establish cavity clearance.

orientation_requirement.description: Select none when no orientation claim is needed, or upright when the selected object's visible rim normal must agree with world up. Without admissible rim points, upright evidence is unknown; no PCA object axis is invented.

rim.description: Optional manually selected visible circular rim on the object, bound to the object_ref source camera. Circle fitting measures this selected rim normal, not cup identity or a PCA axis.

camera.description: Camera that produced object_ref; the runtime rejects a different source camera.

points_uv.description: Six to twelve ordered points on the same visible circular rim in native RGB pixels; all must be inside the source image and admissible object region with valid depth.

items.description: One [u,v] pixel in top-left OpenCV coordinates.
Non-negative native-image pixel coordinate; image bounds are checked at invocation.

protected_before_refs.description: Zero to three earlier same-round target_refs for protected visible regions, index-aligned with protected_current_refs: entry i is the earlier state of the region named by protected_current_refs[i]. Both arrays must have the same length or the call is refused with the shorter field named. Dimensionless references; future or cross-round references are rejected.

items.description: One earlier same-round target_ref for a protected visible region. Dimensionless reference, not a coordinate.

protected_current_refs.description: Zero to three current-observation target_refs selecting the regions intended to match protected_before_refs entry by entry, of the same length as it. Dimensionless references; the association stays the Agent's responsibility and is never authenticated identity.

items.description: One current-observation target_ref for a protected visible region. Dimensionless reference, not a coordinate.

prior_assessment_ref.description: Immutable same-round assessment identifier for audit comparison only; never an executable motion handle.

phase.description: Request one next placement step: preplace alignment, lower approach, or a short post-release exit; not a complete execution script.
